hook: Your satellite map shows India reaching toward Sri Lanka.
title: Your Map Shows a 48 km Chain to Sri Lanka
description:
Adam's Bridge, also called Ram Setu, is a chain of shoals between India and Sri Lanka. It runs about 48 km between Pamban Island and Mannar Island. Open your satellite map and zoom in yourself. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #RamSetu #Geography
comment_prompt: Have you seen it on satellite? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your satellite map shows India reaching toward Sri Lanka.
scenes.headline: India Reaches Sri Lanka

scenes.narration: It's a chain of shoals, about 48 kilometres long.
scenes.headline: A Chain Of Shoals

scenes.narration: Zoom in and it looks like a bridge.
scenes.headline: It Looks Like A Bridge

scenes.narration: It's called Adam's Bridge, or Ram Setu.
scenes.headline: Adam's Bridge, Ram Setu

scenes.narration: It runs between Pamban Island and Mannar Island.
scenes.headline: Pamban To Mannar

scenes.narration: The water over it is very shallow.
scenes.headline: Very Shallow Water

scenes.narration: Your satellite map shows that chain right now.
scenes.headline: Check It Yourself

scenes.headline: Tomorrow: No Lights
